help.title: Help
help.q1: The QR code doesn’t open anything?
help.a1: Computer and phone must be on the same Wi-Fi. Guest networks often keep devices apart.
help.a2: Allow QR Drop in your firewall (Windows: “Private networks”, macOS: “Allow incoming connections”).
help.q3: Where is the file on my phone?
help.a3: iPhone: Files app → Downloads. Android: notifications or Files app → Downloads.
help.a4: Files travel directly over your Wi-Fi, never through the internet. Each code is valid for 10 minutes and one download.
error.clipboard_empty.title: Clipboard is empty
error.clipboard_empty.text: Copy some text or a link first.
error.text_too_large.title: Text is too long
error.text_too_large.text: More than 1 MB of text doesn’t fit.
error.text_too_large.hint: Save it as a file and send the file.
welcome.text: For text: select it → right-click → Services → “Send text via QR code”.
receive.title: Receive from phone
receive.connected.text: Choose photos, files or text on your phone.
receive.more: More? Just choose them on your phone.
receive.interrupted: Connection lost – continues automatically once the phone is back.
receive.expired.text: The code expires after 10 minutes without transfers.
help.q5: How do I get something from my phone to the computer?
help.a5: Choose “Receive from phone” (Windows: also in the Start menu, Mac: also in the Services menu) and scan the QR code. Files are saved to “Downloads”, texts go to the clipboard.
